How a model enters, and leaves
A model passes six acceptance checks before it answers anything real, and the checks re-run on a cadence. Failing one takes it out of service the same day — no exception path exists.

What a rule profile is
Every rule answers the same two questions: what promise it holds up, and what it changes about the way the system feels day to day. A rule that protected nothing, or cost nothing, would not survive this page.
The gates
Four gates govern the book — masking, permission, evidence and exit. Every ask passes at least two.
+1 recommended — a release-review gate for outbound documents.
−1 recommended — the legacy VPN gate duplicates the exit gate.

How rules change
Someone proposes it, a second person signs off, a countdown runs in the open, then it applies and is re-checked. Adopting a rulebook and changing a single rule move through the same ceremony.
